title: Check the mirror password that ignores spaces
goal: combines cleaning, array inversion and comparison to solve a short algorithmic task.
summary: ignores uppercase and lowercase and ordinary spaces when verifying English workstation passwords. Compare the sanitized string with its reverse order.
tasks: Complete isMirrorCode(text), unify English letters in upper and lower case, remove all ordinary spaces, and then check whether the forward and reverse order are the same.
returns false when there are no remaining characters. Numbers and other ASCII symbols are still compared.

example.note: string has no reverse method. First convert it into a character array, and then concatenate the reversed characters back into a string.

hint: The cleaned string must be non-empty. Don't just remove the spaces at both ends.
